import re

def extract_grid(txt, label, end_marker):
    start=txt.index(label)+len(label)
    end=txt.index(end_marker,start)
    lines=txt[start:end].strip().splitlines()
    rows=[]
    for line in lines:
        vals=[int(x) for x in line.split() if x.isdigit()]
        if vals: rows.append(vals)
    return rows
